failure.message: The VM ocp-c200-kv32-five-k7q2m9xd made on KV cluster ocp4-prod-kv-five-az1-a for InfraEnv c200-kv32-az1 could not be installed into inventory — were installed and never registered an Agent before the deadline, so each was rolled back and its machine returned to the inventory. An Agent appears once the host boots the discovery ISO and reaches assisted-service, so what failed is DOWNSTREAM of the BareMetalHost — the BMC, the bond, the VLAN, or DHCP on that inventory segment. Each entry below says which of those the host's own state points at: ocp-c200-kv32-five-k7q2m9xd (no Agent in 60 min; provisioning state 'available', operationalStatus 'OK'. Ironic raised no registration error, so the BMC answered and the host was driven to boot — look at the VM's NIC, the VLAN and DHCP on this segment, not at the BMC). Its host could not be taken out of the MCE (BmhDeletionTimeoutError: Rolling ocp-c200-kv32-five-k7q2m9xd back (no Agent within 1:00:00): its BareMetalHost in inventory is still deleting 0:15:00 after the delete (metal3: state 'powering off before delete', operationalStatus 'error', error 'Failed to power off: BMC unreachable'). Its finalizer is left to metal3, which lets the host go only once it has powered it off and deleted its ironic node — usually it cannot reach the BMC. The NMStateConfig is deleted; the VM ocp-c200-kv32-five-k7q2m9xd is kept on KV cluster ocp4-prod-kv-five-az1-a, since metal3 still needs its BMC to let the host go. Fix the BMC: metal3 fin). The VM ocp-c200-kv32-five-k7q2m9xd was KEPT on KV cluster ocp4-prod-kv-five-az1-a (label redbull.io/created-by=d51156b3-cef6-47a2-ba50-1812d69f4b4c): delete it once its BareMetalHost is gone
